🌸 Ovarian Cysts: Understanding the Signs & Care 🌸

Ovarian cysts are fluid-filled sacs that can develop within or on the surface of the ovaries. They are a relatively common condition among women of reproductive age and may form due to hormonal changes, ovulation, pregnancy, or underlying health conditions. In many cases, ovarian cysts are harmless and disappear naturally without causing noticeable symptoms.

However, some cysts may lead to pelvic pain, bloating, irregular periods, or discomfort during daily activities. If left untreated, certain cysts can grow larger or cause complications such as rupture or twisting of the ovary. Early diagnosis through regular gynecological check-ups and ultrasound evaluation plays an important role in managing ovarian cysts effectively and preventing complications.

What is SSG? 🌸

SSG (Saline Sonohysterography) is a special ultrasound test where saline is gently used to clearly see the inside of the uterus.

SSG helps detect:
✅ Uterine polyps
✅ Fibroids
✅ Adhesions or scars
✅ Causes of infertility
✅ Causes of recurrent pregnancy loss

A clear and healthy uterine cavity can improve the chances of implantation and pregnancy. Early diagnosis helps your fertility specialist plan the right treatment at the right time. 💛

At Sunrise Fertility & IVF Centre, we provide accurate fertility evaluation and personalized care for every couple’s parenthood journey.

When Should You Get an HSG Test? 🌸

An HSG (Hysterosalpingography) is a simple X-ray test that checks whether your fallopian tubes are open and evaluates the shape of your uterus. It is an important investigation for couples facing difficulty conceiving.

Your doctor may recommend an HSG if:
✅ You have been trying to conceive for 1 year without success (or 6 months if you are over 35)
✅ Pregnancy is not happening despite regular ovulation
✅ You are planning IUI treatment
✅ There is a suspicion of blocked fallopian tubes or unexplained infertility

Blocked fallopian tubes can prevent the egg and sperm from meeting, making natural conception difficult. Identifying the cause early helps your fertility specialist choose the most appropriate treatment.

💛 Early diagnosis leads to better fertility planning and improved chances of pregnancy.

What is Follicular Study? 🌸

Follicular study is a series of ultrasound scans done to track egg growth and identify the right time of ovulation.

It helps in:
✅ Knowing the exact ovulation day
✅ Tracking follicle/egg growth
✅ Timing intercourse or IUI correctly
✅ Improving chances of pregnancy

Right timing can make all the difference when you are trying to conceive. Follicular study helps identify your most fertile days and supports better fertility planning.

At Sunrise Fertility & IVF Centre, we guide couples with accurate monitoring and personalized fertility care. 💛

What is Unexplained Infertility? 🤔🌸

Unexplained infertility means all common fertility reports may look normal, but pregnancy is still not happening.

Common tests may show normal:
✅ Ovulation
✅ Semen analysis
✅ Fallopian tubes
✅ Hormone levels

But sometimes, the cause may be hidden — like egg quality, sperm function, fertilization issues, implantation problems, or mild endometriosis.

The good news is: treatment options are available. 💛
With expert evaluation, personalized planning, and timely treatment, many couples can still achieve pregnancy.

Don’t lose hope. Consult a fertility specialist and take the next step toward parenthood. ✨

featured_reviews.name: Cloud Nest
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is my honest review. I strongly suggest you stay away from Dr. Sargam Soni.

She is only interested in draining your money, not treating you. Every visit ends up costing between ₹13,000 to ₹20,000 — and for what? A two-minute consultation where she says one random line, no proper advice, no clarity. She just pushes expensive medicines (which she sells herself), overpriced tests (only from her tie-up labs), and useless repeat visits every 2 weeks. It’s a complete money-making setup.

Even though we live next to one of the best scanning and diagnostic centres in Mumbai, she flat-out refused to accept any reports from there. Why? Because she won’t earn her cut. The labs she sends you to charge 40–50% more than normal rates. Same with the medicines — you can easily get 10–15% discount outside, but she tells you to buy only from her.

It honestly felt like she’s just running a business, not a clinic. Every single thing — scans, medicines, visits — is planned to squeeze as much money as possible. Forget results — you won’t even get proper attention. And during all my visits, I never saw a single patient in the waiting area — only medical reps. Makes me wonder who’s actually writing all those positive reviews online.

Even worse, her clinic staff is totally untrained. There are 2–3 nurses (not even sure if they’re qualified) who don’t even know what something basic like an HbA1c test is and had to go and ask her. One of them poked my hand painfully again and again trying to draw blood — and once, the blood even squirted out because she didn’t know what she was doing.

They don’t allow you to take a photo of the cost breakdown for medicines or tests — probably because they know it’s overpriced and shady. That alone says a lot.

She spends more time talking about herself than helping the patient. Total show-off attitude, super arrogant, and completely disinterested once she’s taken your money.

This was one of the worst medical experiences I’ve ever had. I genuinely regret going. Please don’t fall for the fake image and waste your hard-earned money like I did.

Words fall short in conveying our gratitude. As a family, we are forever indebted to her.
I wholeheartedly and strongly recommend Dr. Harita Kothia to anyone looking for a highly skilled, compassionate, and dedicated obstetrician and gynaecologist.

With immense respect and gratitude,

featured_reviews.name: Priyanka Verma
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dr. Vidya Patil was our hero throughout our pregnancy and we thank her from the bottom of our hearts.
Our relationship with her transitioned naturally from that of a patient and doctor (as normally expected) to that of a parent-to-be and mentor. Dr. Vidya kept us informed of our progress all through. With her by our side, we like to think that ours was indeed a normal (caesarean) delivery!
She also served as rock-solid support for us, with her crystal clear inputs and logical advice. Our support system on Arya Womens Hospital  was completed by several other special people, including the wonderful nurses; in particular, Sisters Aarti,Jansi, and Pooja.
Overall, Arya Womens Hospital was a fantastic experience. The fact that all the medical facilities were housed under one roof, right from the pharmacy to the pathology lab, made every consultation smooth. Memorable gestures that will forever be etched in our hearts and minds will be the way she arranged a beautiful decorated cake for us the day after our baby’s birth.
Thank you, Dr.Vidya for running this chain so professionally, yet so personally.
